decisions.reason: This IMU module fits the core building-block system and shares its firmware, bindings and production, so keeping it costs little while demand is still unknown.
The industrial AC input module has its own page and supports the firm's push into industrial automation and energy, so the option is worth holding open at low cost.
The solid state relay module is a close extension of the existing relay range and needs little extra cost to keep, so there is no reason to abandon it this early.
The server room kit only bundles existing modules, so keeping it is cheap, although kits are easier to drop if sales stay weak.
